title: Racing
description: Up to 24 cars on Jolt's vehicle physics: NASCAR-style oval races where hits dent the body, bend the wheels and hurt the engine (pit to repair), drifting for points round the docks, and a quarter-mile drag strip with a Christmas tree and a manual gearbox. Split screen for four, online with Host / Join. Tyre smoke, skid marks, sparks and flying bodywork.
